#!/bin/bash

# Log file path
LOG_FILE="/workspace/cpu_monitor.log"

# Start monitoring
echo "Monitoring started at $(date)" > "$LOG_FILE"

# Sample CPU usage every 5 seconds for 1 minute (12 samples)
for i in {1..12}; do
    # Get CPU usage
    CPU_USAGE=$(top -bn1 | grep "%Cpu(s)" | sed "s/.*, *\([0-9.]*\)%* id.*/\1/" | awk '{print 100 - $1}')
    # Get current timestamp
    TIMESTAMP=$(date)
    # Log the sample
    echo "[$TIMESTAMP] CPU: $CPU_USAGE%" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    # Wait for 5 seconds
    sleep 5
done

# End monitoring
echo "Monitoring completed at $(date)" >> "$LOG_FILE"
